body.name: Total nearby-legal-base directional envelope
body.construction: For each \(b\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), set \(\mathcal D_b=\{g\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal J}:q_{xz}(b)=0\text{ and }q_{xz}(g)=0\Longrightarrow g_{xza}=0\text{ for every }a\in\mathcal A,\ x\in\mathcal X,\ z\in\{0,1\}\}\). Define \(d_b(g)=\partial_+\bar\Phi(b;g)=\lim_{t\downarrow0}\{\bar\Phi(b+tg)-\bar\Phi(b)\}/t\) for every \(g\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal J}\). Set \(B_n=\{b\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{obs}}:\|b-\widehat p_n\|_\infty\le a_n\}\). Define \(T_n(g)=\sup_{b\in B_n}\|d_b(g)\|_\infty\) when \(B_n\ne\varnothing\), and \(T_n(g)=0\) when \(B_n=\varnothing\). Values \(d_b(g)\) for \(g\notin\mathcal D_b\) are total calibration scaffolding only.
